notes_for_editor: Existence and standing rest only on the Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia list, which also lists Caret (Upper Essex) as a separate standing tower. The Forest Lookouts page is a name-and-county stub. Wikipedia's Center Cross page is an unincorporated community in Essex County with no tower detail, so it is not cited. Two WebSearch queries returned a TopoQuest place page, a Browne State Forest page that gives a Center Cross address but no tower mention, and a registered antenna structure and an early-1800s house at Center Cross, neither of which is the lookout. A search snippet gave a row reading PRIVATE (Essex County) (formerly VDOF), Standing (2008), but its source page could not be opened and the wording is not in any Center Cross page read, so it is not used. Owner and access unknown. Next checks if wanted: the Association's Center Cross detail page, an NHLR listing, Virginia Department of Forestry records, and Essex County records.
